verdict.rationale: n8n documents an official command-line page and a programmatic n8n API, and it can be self-hosted via Docker Compose or a one-line install script. Those are the product's own surfaces for headless operation. However, the evidence shows only page titles, with no detail on running or exporting workflows from the CLI, non-interactive auth, or CI pipeline usage. missing for 10: documented headless workflow execution commands, CI integration guidance or examples, non-interactive auth details, independent hands-on corroboration of CI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: You can self-host n8n on your own infrastructure, on-premises, or in a private cloud, using Docker Compose, one-line setup, or other deployment methods.
